Figure 2: Overview of the MemVLN Architecture. Given a natural language instruction and monocular RGB observations, MemVLN utilizes an Episodic Memory module to construct pyramidal resolution observation. Complementarily, the Procedural Memory maintains a set of single-token mid-level actions to enable fast navigation.
Figure 4: Pyramidal Resolution vs. Token Merging. Our pyramidal resolution ensures compatibility with modern LVLM design such as M-RoPE and DeepStack.

Figure 3: Attention analysis across visual observations. Left: The final four frames account for over 50% of the total visual attention. Middle: The more recent observation receives higher concentration of attention. Right: Attention scores increase significantly as observations become more recent.
